sources.title: NASA/JPL Small-Body Database
sources.reading_scope: Complete retained catalogue and 13 detailed object records; API field, uncertainty and signature documentation inspected. Individual parameter references and caveats retained in product.
sources.limits: A mixed curated catalogue, not an independent mine assay; missing diameters and taxonomies remain missing.

sources.title: NASA/JPL NHATS
sources.reading_scope: API query parameters, result definitions and complete selected summary response read.
sources.limits: Human Earth round trips in a finite launch window; no recurring cislunar cargo route qualification.

sources.title: Nugent et al., NEOWISE Reactivation Year Two
sources.reading_scope: Abstract and diameter/albedo comparison discussion, PDF pp.13–15; selected model-error interpretation.
sources.limits: 20% diameter/40% albedo comparison scatter is sample/method dependent; no universal prior or confidence interval imposed.

sources.title: Masiero et al., NEOWISE Reactivation Years Six and Seven
sources.reading_scope: Abstract, formal fitting uncertainty discussion and diameter accuracy section 5.1 inspected.
sources.limits: 30% comparison scatter motivates an additional structural scenario, not a pooled Gaussian error law.

sources.title: Yokoyama et al., Samples returned from Ryugu
sources.reading_scope: Author-institution PDF abstract and journal p.7 water-release/content discussion; https://faculty.epss.ucla.edu/~eyoung/reprints/Yokoyama_2022.pdf
sources.limits: 6.84 ± 0.34 wt% sample H2O equivalent; structural hydroxyl dominates. No candidate-wide assay or industrial recovery estimate.

sources.title: Frozen enclosed-industry engineering product
sources.reading_scope: Subset copied with upstream SHA-256 and source commit in inputs/cost_coefficients.json. Equipment rates, prices, lifetimes, margins and allowances inspected.
sources.limits: Engineering assumptions, not observed industrial costs. A chemistry-per-watt proxy for thermal extraction is newly proposed and explicitly unqualified.

sources.title: Lunar primary survey and process sources
sources.reading_scope: Detailed per-source reading and archive identities in the companion register.
sources.limits: Spatial composition and formal covariance, not approved site reserves.

sources.title: Project conservation and cargo requirements
sources.reading_scope: Seven pinned local source records; accepted decisions and proposed conditions distinguished individually.
sources.limits: Evaluator tests supporting-record completeness; does not verify attestation truth or authorize extraction.

sources.title: Marsset et al. (2022) MITHNEOS spectral catalogue
sources.reading_scope: Methods, class flags and selection/debiasing discussion; complete publisher Table 7 joined by object identity, checked against CDS mirror. Exact bytes and reading record in composition_inputs.json.
sources.limits: Taxonomic families and conditional missing-label allocation, not measured ore grades; published 420-object versus 419-identity discrepancy retained.

sources.title: LCDB 2023 and pro-am observation coverage
sources.reading_scope: Complete fixed-width summary, README field map and reliability definitions. Independent ALCDEF access checked; identities and terms in lightcurve_inputs.json.
sources.limits: Rotation/shape context only. No LCDB assumed sizes/composition imported; no ALCDEF photometry redistributed. BAA yielded no candidate spectra; M4AST retrieval failed, with no substitute data or claim.

rights: External raw catalogues and full papers remain outside Git. Derived calculations include source credit and hashes. Independent catalogue rights and source identities are retained in their own products.
